title: What makes a theorem interesting? Operationalizing interestingness for open-ended exploration
title_zh: 什么使定理有趣？为开放式探索操作化「有趣性」

paragraphs.en: 以数学定理为对象操作化有趣性,构建评估器框架量化结果被标举的共享与主观特征。 An agent that explores, whether it generates conjectures or research ideas, must decide which of them are worth keeping. This judgment of interestingness is usually delegated to a hand-picked proxy or to a language model, neither of which is known to correspond to what humans actually value. I study it for mathematical theorems, by observing which results mathematicians single out in formal libraries and in papers. I model each way of singling out results as an evaluator that weights features of a result's statement, its proof and dependencies, and split its weights into a shared and a subjective part. In formalized mathematics, ex-ante features predict these selections as well as a large language-model judge, and the two complement each other. Interestingness is also largely shared. One set of weights, carried mostly by structural features such as the length of the statement and of the proof and the subfields the proof draws on, accounts for most of the signal and transfers in part across formal libraries. What remains subjective depends on practices and individual authors more than on subfields. The judge's advantage lies in its knowledge of the canon, and neither the judge nor the features rely on memory of the papers. The approach, which infers what a community finds interesting from what it singles out, can be applied to other sciences.
paragraphs.zh: 探索的智能体，无论是提出猜想还是研究思路，都必须决定哪些值得保留。 对有趣性的判断通常交给一个精心挑选的代理或一个语言模型，但这两者是否对应人类真正看重的东西尚属未知。 我针对数学定理研究这一问题，方法是观察数学家在形式化库和论文中标举了哪些结果。 我把每一种标举结果的方式建模为一个评估器，它对结果的陈述、证明及其依赖关系的特征赋予权重，并将这些权重分为共享部分与主观部分。 在形式化数学中，事前特征对这些选择的预测能力不亚于一个大型语言模型裁判，且二者互为补充。 有趣性在很大程度上也是共享的。 一组权重主要由结构性特征承担，例如陈述与证明的长度以及证明所涉及的子领域，它解释了大部分信号，并能在一定程度上跨形式化库迁移。 剩下的主观部分更多取决于惯例和个体作者，而非子领域。 裁判的优势在于它对经典文献的了解，而裁判和特征都不依赖于对论文的记忆。 这种从社群所标举的内容中推断其认为何为有趣的方法，可以应用于其他科学领域。
